query:
SELECT 
  ua.id, ua.actionType, ua.description, ua.feature, ua.status, ua.errorMessage, ua.createdAt
FROM user_actions ua
JOIN app_users u ON u.id = ua.appUserId
WHERE u.email LIKE '%8822705%'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt ASC;
